description: This file defines a React functional component named PlatformChart that renders a doughnut chart visualizing platform spend data, using chart.js and react-chartjs-2 libraries. It includes configuration for chart appearance, tooltips, and labels, and exports the component for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: PlatformChart
methods.description: React functional component that renders a doughnut chart based on provided data, with customized legend and tooltip configurations.
